select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'INDIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'PROMO BURNISHED TIN'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select o_totalprice, o_shippriority, n_comment from orders, customer, nation where o_orderstatus < 'O' AND c_acctbal = 1481.44 AND c_name = 'Customer#000143733' AND c_mktsegment > 'BUILDING' AND c_nationkey < 4

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'EGYPT' and n2.n_name = 'ALGERIA')     or (n1.n_name = 'ALGERIA' and n2.n_name = 'EGYPT')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select  s_name,  s_address from  supplier,  nation where  s_suppkey in (   select    ps_suppkey   from    partsupp   where    ps_partkey in (     select      p_partkey     from      part     where      p_name like 'tomato%'    )    and ps_availqty > (     select      0.5 * sum(l_quantity)     from      lineitem     where      l_partkey = ps_partkey      and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey      and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'      and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year    )  )  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'FRANCE' order by  s_name ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 29  and p_type like '%STEEL'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'ASIA'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

SELECT l_linenumber, c_address, o_orderdate, ps_supplycost FROM customer JOIN orders ON o_custkey = c_custkey JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey WHERE l_returnflag >= 'R' AND c_custkey >= 149303 AND c_acctbal >= 7048.34 AND l_discount > 0.04 ORDER BY l_linenumber DESC

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'IRAN' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'STANDARD ANODIZED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

SELECT n_comment, o_orderpriority, c_comment, SUM(o_totalprice), MAX(n_comment) FROM orders, customer, nation WHERE n_regionkey <= 2 AND o_shippriority < 0 AND c_address = 'T7atVtPnd,LBdFg8BUqYBUab' AND o_orderpriority > '3-MEDIUM' GROUP BY n_comment, o_orderpriority, c_comment

select  sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  lineitem,  part where  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#52'   and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')   and l_quantity >= 4 and l_quantity <= 4 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 5   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#42'   and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')   and l_quantity >= 10 and l_quantity <= 10 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 10   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#51'   and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')   and l_quantity >= 25 and l_quantity <= 25 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 15   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  ) ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('20', '33', '24', '26', '29', '12', '14')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('20', '33', '24', '26', '29', '12', '14')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'RUSSIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'EUROPE'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'ECONOMY BURNISHED STEEL'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'BRAZIL' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AMERICA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'SMALL BRUSHED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'UNITED KINGDOM' and n2.n_name = 'BRAZIL')     or (n1.n_name = 'BRAZIL' and n2.n_name = 'UNITED KINGDOM')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select ps_suppkey, s_comment, r_comment, s_phone, count(s_suppkey) from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where ps_partkey > 146694 AND s_phone >= '27-539-310-7067' group by ps_suppkey, s_comment, s_phone, r_comment order by ps_suppkey DESC, s_phone DESC

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('22', '24', '15', '25', '34', '10', '19')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('22', '24', '15', '25', '34', '10', '19')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '95' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select  o_orderpriority,  count(*) as order_count from  orders where  o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '3' month  and exists (   select    *   from    lineitem   where    l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  ) group by  o_orderpriority order by  o_orderpriority ;

select ps_availqty, s_suppkey, n_comment from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey where n_regionkey < 0 AND ps_availqty >= 3514 AND n_nationkey >= 5 order by ps_availqty ASC

select  o_orderpriority,  count(*) as order_count from  orders where  o_orderdate >= date '1996-08-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1996-08-01' + interval '3' month  and exists (   select    *   from    lineitem   where    l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  ) group by  o_orderpriority order by  o_orderpriority ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 41  and p_type like '%COPPER'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'EUROPE'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'EUROPE'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  l_shipmode,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'    or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as high_line_count,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT'    and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as low_line_count from  orders,  lineitem where  o_orderkey = l_orderkey  and l_shipmode in ('MAIL', 'RAIL')  and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  and l_shipdate < l_commitdate  and l_receiptdate >= date '1997-01-01'  and l_receiptdate < date '1997-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  l_shipmode order by  l_shipmode ;

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' and n2.n_name = 'ALGERIA')     or (n1.n_name = 'ALGERIA' and n2.n_name = 'UNITED STATES')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('16', '10', '19', '27', '11', '29', '18')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('16', '10', '19', '27', '11', '29', '18')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  n_name,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  customer,  orders,  lineitem,  supplier,  nation,  region where  c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and l_suppkey = s_suppkey  and c_nationkey = s_nationkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AMERICA'  and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  n_name order by  revenue desc ;

select p_mfgr, ps_availqty, min(p_container) from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey where ps_availqty = 9188 AND p_mfgr = 'Manufacturer#4' AND ps_partkey <= 180166 group by p_mfgr, ps_availqty having min(p_container) = 'LG PKG'

SELECT ps_comment, p_size, l_orderkey FROM lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN part ON p_partkey = ps_partkey WHERE l_discount <> 0.09 AND l_suppkey < 8552 AND l_extendedprice = 63256.71 AND l_linestatus <= 'O'

select s_suppkey, s_name, l_comment from supplier JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_shipinstruct = 'NONE' AND s_name = 'Supplier#000000551' AND ps_partkey = 59366 order by l_comment DESC, s_suppkey ASC

select p_name, ps_partkey, l_orderkey from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_commitdate = '1992-11-26' AND l_linestatus = 'O' AND p_type = 'STANDARD BRUSHED BRASS' AND l_orderkey < 2618950 AND ps_comment > 'ronic dolphins must wake slyly ruthlessly bold ideas. furiously even requests across the quickly ironic in' order by ps_partkey DESC, p_name ASC

select  n_name,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  customer,  orders,  lineitem,  supplier,  nation,  region where  c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and l_suppkey = s_suppkey  and c_nationkey = s_nationkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AMERICA'  and o_orderdate >= date '1995-01-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  n_name order by  revenue desc ;

select l_commitdate, ps_availqty from lineitem, partsupp where l_linestatus = 'O' AND l_orderkey < 56675 AND l_tax < 0.06 AND l_extendedprice = 2430.26

select c_nationkey, o_custkey, n_regionkey, r_name from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where c_name = 'Customer#000060617' AND o_comment < 'uriously unusual pinto beans. idly ironic depo' AND o_orderdate = '1995-09-22' order by o_custkey ASC, n_regionkey DESC, r_name ASC

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'ALGERIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AFRICA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'ECONOMY POLISHED TIN'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  o_orderpriority,  count(*) as order_count from  orders where  o_orderdate >= date '1995-09-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1995-09-01' + interval '3' month  and exists (   select    *   from    lineitem   where    l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  ) group by  o_orderpriority order by  o_orderpriority ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 46  and p_type like '%STEEL'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AFRICA'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AFRICA'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '108' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('19', '17', '33', '23', '18', '26', '10')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('19', '17', '33', '23', '18', '26', '10')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  l_shipmode,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'    or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as high_line_count,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT'    and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as low_line_count from  orders,  lineitem where  o_orderkey = l_orderkey  and l_shipmode in ('FOB', 'REG AIR')  and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  and l_shipdate < l_commitdate  and l_receiptdate >= date '1993-01-01'  and l_receiptdate < date '1993-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  l_shipmode order by  l_shipmode ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'INDIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'MEDIUM BURNISHED NICKEL'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  lineitem,  part where  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#11'   and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')   and l_quantity >= 7 and l_quantity <= 7 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 5   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#22'   and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')   and l_quantity >= 15 and l_quantity <= 15 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 10   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#54'   and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')   and l_quantity >= 22 and l_quantity <= 22 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 15   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  ) ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('25', '22', '20', '32', '33', '27', '14')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('25', '22', '20', '32', '33', '27', '14')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  lineitem,  part where  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#14'   and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')   and l_quantity >= 7 and l_quantity <= 7 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 5   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#31'   and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')   and l_quantity >= 15 and l_quantity <= 15 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 10   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#31'   and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')   and l_quantity >= 30 and l_quantity <= 30 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 15   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  ) ;

select  l_shipmode,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'    or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as high_line_count,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT'    and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as low_line_count from  orders,  lineitem where  o_orderkey = l_orderkey  and l_shipmode in ('RAIL', 'MAIL')  and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  and l_shipdate < l_commitdate  and l_receiptdate >= date '1994-01-01'  and l_receiptdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  l_shipmode order by  l_shipmode ;

select  s_name,  s_address from  supplier,  nation where  s_suppkey in (   select    ps_suppkey   from    partsupp   where    ps_partkey in (     select      p_partkey     from      part     where      p_name like 'dark%'    )    and ps_availqty > (     select      0.5 * sum(l_quantity)     from      lineitem     where      l_partkey = ps_partkey      and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey      and l_shipdate >= date '1995-01-01'      and l_shipdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year    )  )  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'GERMANY' order by  s_name ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'CHINA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'ECONOMY BRUSHED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'ALGERIA' and n2.n_name = 'EGYPT')     or (n1.n_name = 'EGYPT' and n2.n_name = 'ALGERIA')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 3  and p_type like '%TIN'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AFRICA'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AFRICA'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

SELECT p_type, ps_comment, s_phone FROM part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_partkey >= 152695 AND ps_comment < 'wake carefully silently final packages. carefully even deposits use special, re' AND s_address > 'CD6mwylfDc2CrjrEKzSbK9LbGEC9irn' ORDER BY ps_comment ASC

select  ps_partkey,  sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) as value from  partsupp,  supplier,  nation where  ps_suppkey = s_suppkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'CHINA' group by  ps_partkey having   sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (    select     sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000    from     partsupp,     supplier,     nation    where     ps_suppkey = s_suppkey     and s_nationkey = n_nationkey     and n_name = 'CHINA'   ) order by  value desc ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  lineitem,  part where  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#33'   and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')   and l_quantity >= 5 and l_quantity <= 5 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 5   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#34'   and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')   and l_quantity >= 14 and l_quantity <= 14 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 10   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#32'   and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')   and l_quantity >= 22 and l_quantity <= 22 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 15   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  ) ;

select c_acctbal, o_custkey, n_nationkey, o_clerk from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where c_name = 'Customer#000060617' AND o_orderdate < '1995-01-28' AND o_comment = 'ggle. carefully ironic ideas' order by o_custkey ASC, c_acctbal DESC, o_clerk ASC

SELECT o_orderdate, c_name, n_comment, l_comment, MAX(n_name) FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey WHERE l_linenumber = 4 AND c_custkey <= 42930 GROUP BY o_orderdate, c_name, n_comment, l_comment ORDER BY MAX(n_name) DESC

select s_comment, p_retailprice, ps_comment, r_comment, r_name from region JOIN nation ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey JOIN supplier ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN part ON p_partkey = ps_partkey where ps_comment < 'xpress dinos. carefully final pinto beans according to the accounts will have to affix carefully even ideas. silent, unusual packages boost! regular deposi' AND ps_availqty = 8560 AND n_comment = 'al foxes promise slyly according to the regular accounts. bold requests alon'

select p_mfgr, p_retailprice, ps_availqty from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_shipdate > '1992-05-24' AND l_returnflag > 'A' AND ps_supplycost = 334.23 AND l_linenumber = 7 order by p_mfgr DESC, ps_availqty ASC

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 36  and p_type like '%NICKEL'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AFRICA'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AFRICA'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  100.00 * sum(case   when p_type like 'PROMO%'    then l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)   else 0  end) / sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as promo_revenue from  lineitem,  part where  l_partkey = p_partkey  and l_shipdate >= date '1997-01-01'  and l_shipdate < date '1997-01-01' + interval '1' month ;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '92' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select ps_availqty, l_returnflag, o_orderpriority from orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey where o_orderdate > '1995-11-14' AND l_partkey = 9605 AND l_returnflag >= 'R' AND l_shipinstruct = 'TAKE BACK RETURN'

select ps_suppkey, s_comment, r_regionkey, n_regionkey, count(n_nationkey) from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where s_nationkey > 1 AND ps_suppkey >= 8448 group by n_regionkey, s_comment, r_regionkey, ps_suppkey order by ps_suppkey DESC, r_regionkey DESC

select  s_name,  s_address from  supplier,  nation where  s_suppkey in (   select    ps_suppkey   from    partsupp   where    ps_partkey in (     select      p_partkey     from      part     where      p_name like 'royal%'    )    and ps_availqty > (     select      0.5 * sum(l_quantity)     from      lineitem     where      l_partkey = ps_partkey      and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey      and l_shipdate >= date '1993-01-01'      and l_shipdate < date '1993-01-01' + interval '1' year    )  )  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'JAPAN' order by  s_name ;

select ps_suppkey, s_comment, r_regionkey, ps_comment, count(s_nationkey) from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where s_nationkey > 1 AND ps_suppkey >= 3273 group by ps_suppkey, s_comment, ps_comment, r_regionkey order by ps_suppkey ASC, r_regionkey DESC

select s_nationkey, ps_supplycost from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_partkey >= 89084 AND s_comment < 'ular deposits should are express foxes. furiously express excuses haggle busily. furiously' AND ps_availqty <= 9188 AND s_nationkey < 17 AND s_acctbal > 6305.29 AND ps_supplycost <= 91.11

select c_nationkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate, r_name from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where c_name >= 'Customer#000113704' AND o_orderdate < '1995-01-28' AND o_comment = 'ggle. carefully ironic ideas' order by c_nationkey ASC, o_custkey DESC, r_name ASC

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#21'  and p_type not like 'ECONOMY BRUSHED%'  and p_size in (23, 13, 29, 30, 41, 4, 26, 24)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;

SELECT s_comment, ps_partkey, l_shipmode, MIN(s_name), SUM(ps_partkey) FROM lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE s_phone = '17-292-821-2297' AND s_name < 'Supplier#000001926' AND l_partkey > 167548 GROUP BY s_comment, ps_partkey, l_shipmode HAVING MIN(s_name) <= 'Supplier#000006418' ORDER BY SUM(ps_partkey) DESC, MIN(s_name) ASC

SELECT s_acctbal, ps_suppkey FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost = 739.78 AND s_name >= 'Supplier#000004391' AND ps_comment > 'inal ideas integrate furiously furiously bold platelets. furiously final pearls impress among the car' AND ps_partkey <= 136593 ORDER BY s_acctbal ASC

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'IRAN' and n2.n_name = 'MOROCCO')     or (n1.n_name = 'MOROCCO' and n2.n_name = 'IRAN')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'JAPAN' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;
SELECT ps_availqty, p_name FROM partsupp, part WHERE p_partkey < 126438 AND p_brand < 'Brand#54' AND p_retailprice = 1900.84 AND p_name > 'yellow honeydew cornsilk peach wheat'

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 37  and p_type like '%TIN'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'AMERICA'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AMERICA'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '96' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select s_name, s_phone, s_comment, min(s_name), sum(ps_partkey) from lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_partkey = 168525 AND l_shipmode < 'RAIL' AND l_partkey > 167548 group by s_comment, s_phone, s_name having min(s_name) <= 'Supplier#000006418' order by sum(ps_partkey) DESC, min(s_name) ASC

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'UNITED KINGDOM' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'EUROPE'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'LARGE ANODIZED COPPER'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  l_orderkey,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority from  customer,  orders,  lineitem where  c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE'  and c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-21'  and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-21' group by  l_orderkey,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority order by  revenue desc,  o_orderdate limit 10;

select  c_count,  count(*) as custdist from  (   select    c_custkey,    count(o_orderkey)   from    customer left outer join orders on     c_custkey = o_custkey     and o_comment not like '%pending%requests%'   group by    c_custkey  ) as c_orders (c_custkey, c_count) group by  c_count order by  custdist desc,  c_count desc ;

select  l_orderkey,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority from  customer,  orders,  lineitem where  c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'  and c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-06'  and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-06' group by  l_orderkey,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority order by  revenue desc,  o_orderdate limit 10;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('16', '33', '26', '31', '14', '32', '19')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('16', '33', '26', '31', '14', '32', '19')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'IRAN' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'MEDIUM BURNISHED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

SELECT l_shipmode, ps_availqty FROM partsupp JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE l_commitdate = '1995-11-21' AND l_shipdate <> '1994-05-24' AND l_quantity <> 2.0 AND ps_supplycost <= 57.43 AND l_shipmode < 'MAIL' ORDER BY l_shipmode ASC

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#41'  and p_type not like 'STANDARD BURNISHED%'  and p_size in (22, 44, 43, 6, 13, 19, 20, 49)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;
SELECT o_orderpriority, c_acctbal FROM customer, orders WHERE o_orderpriority < '4-NOT SPECIFIED' AND c_address <= '1uItjXUxfvnTPgCh' AND c_phone > '13-675-522-6406' AND o_shippriority > 0

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('31', '20', '10', '30', '15', '18', '24')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('31', '20', '10', '30', '15', '18', '24')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  lineitem,  part where  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#43'   and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')   and l_quantity >= 10 and l_quantity <= 10 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 5   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#15'   and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')   and l_quantity >= 10 and l_quantity <= 10 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 10   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  )  or  (   p_partkey = l_partkey   and p_brand = 'Brand#21'   and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')   and l_quantity >= 30 and l_quantity <= 30 + 10   and p_size between 1 and 15   and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG')   and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'  ) ;

select ps_availqty, s_name, p_mfgr, n_name, r_comment from region JOIN nation ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey JOIN supplier ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN part ON p_partkey = ps_partkey where ps_comment < 'the quick excuses use daringly around the blithely pending packages. foxes use quickly. fluffily r' AND n_comment = 'ously. final, express gifts cajole a' AND r_name = 'EUROPE'

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#55'  and p_type not like 'PROMO PLATED%'  and p_size in (18, 11, 43, 33, 19, 40, 45, 29)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '85' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 44  and p_type like '%TIN'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  n_name,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from  customer,  orders,  lineitem,  supplier,  nation,  region where  c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and l_suppkey = s_suppkey  and c_nationkey = s_nationkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'ASIA'  and o_orderdate >= date '1995-01-01'  and o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  n_name order by  revenue desc ;

select l_partkey, s_comment, l_shipmode, min(s_name), sum(ps_partkey) from lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_partkey = 138335 AND s_name < 'Supplier#000001926' AND s_phone > '27-639-321-9156' group by s_comment, l_shipmode, l_partkey having min(s_name) <= 'Supplier#000006418' order by sum(ps_partkey) DESC, min(s_name) ASC

SELECT p_name, ps_availqty FROM partsupp, part WHERE p_container <= 'LG CASE' AND p_brand > 'Brand#32' AND ps_comment = 'e carefully pending foxes sleep furiously among the slyly special requests. blithely final req' AND p_type > 'MEDIUM BRUSHED NICKEL' ORDER BY ps_availqty ASC, p_name ASC

select  s_name,  s_address from  supplier,  nation where  s_suppkey in (   select    ps_suppkey   from    partsupp   where    ps_partkey in (     select      p_partkey     from      part     where      p_name like 'cornflower%'    )    and ps_availqty > (     select      0.5 * sum(l_quantity)     from      lineitem     where      l_partkey = ps_partkey      and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey      and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'      and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year    )  )  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'ALGERIA' order by  s_name ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('29', '17', '31', '22', '12', '28', '18')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('29', '17', '31', '22', '12', '28', '18')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

select  ps_partkey,  sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) as value from  partsupp,  supplier,  nation where  ps_suppkey = s_suppkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA' group by  ps_partkey having   sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (    select     sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000    from     partsupp,     supplier,     nation    where     ps_suppkey = s_suppkey     and s_nationkey = n_nationkey     and n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'   ) order by  value desc ;

SELECT ps_partkey, o_comment, l_shipmode, MAX(o_shippriority) FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey WHERE l_quantity >= 35.0 AND ps_availqty < 7758 AND ps_suppkey <> 5063 AND o_orderkey = 61024 GROUP BY ps_partkey, o_comment, l_shipmode ORDER BY ps_partkey ASC, o_comment ASC

select l_orderkey, p_name, ps_partkey from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_linestatus = 'O' AND p_type = 'ECONOMY BURNISHED TIN' AND l_commitdate = '1993-10-02' AND l_orderkey < 2618950 AND ps_comment > 'ronic dolphins must wake slyly ruthlessly bold ideas. furiously even requests across the quickly ironic in' order by ps_partkey DESC, p_name ASC

SELECT l_commitdate, ps_suppkey, s_phone, AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE s_address >= 'H5tDfi,XJ8BuciyUcOao1WXbXOWIGBR' AND ps_availqty = 7950 GROUP BY l_commitdate, ps_suppkey, s_phone HAVING AVG(ps_supplycost) < 160.7 ORDER BY ps_suppkey DESC, l_commitdate ASC, s_phone ASC

select s_comment, ps_partkey, l_shipmode, min(s_name), sum(ps_partkey) from lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where s_phone = '24-810-371-6779' AND s_name < 'Supplier#000001275' AND l_partkey > 167548 group by s_comment, ps_partkey, l_shipmode having min(s_name) <= 'Supplier#000004985' order by sum(ps_partkey) DESC, min(s_name) ASC
SELECT o_shippriority FROM orders WHERE o_clerk > 'Clerk#000000950' AND o_shippriority <> 0 AND o_custkey >= 131045 AND o_orderpriority >= '4-NOT SPECIFIED' AND o_orderkey > 374980

select  l_orderkey,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority from  customer,  orders,  lineitem where  c_mktsegment = 'HOUSEHOLD'  and c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-04'  and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-04' group by  l_orderkey,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority order by  revenue desc,  o_orderdate limit 10;

select s_comment, s_nationkey from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_availqty >= 1207 AND s_acctbal < 5433.53 AND ps_supplycost <= 57.43 AND ps_partkey < 5804 AND s_nationkey > 20 AND ps_supplycost <= 91.11

select p_mfgr, ps_availqty, min(p_container) from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey where ps_availqty = 1178 AND p_mfgr = 'Manufacturer#4' AND ps_partkey <= 198332 group by p_mfgr, ps_availqty having min(p_container) = 'LG PKG'

select  ps_partkey,  sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) as value from  partsupp,  supplier,  nation where  ps_suppkey = s_suppkey  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'IRAN' group by  ps_partkey having   sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (    select     sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000    from     partsupp,     supplier,     nation    where     ps_suppkey = s_suppkey     and s_nationkey = n_nationkey     and n_name = 'IRAN'   ) order by  value desc ;

select  l_orderkey,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority from  customer,  orders,  lineitem where  c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'  and c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-19'  and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-19' group by  l_orderkey,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority order by  revenue desc,  o_orderdate limit 10;

select  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus,  sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,  sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,  avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,  avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,  avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,  count(*) as count_order from  lineitem where  l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '113' day group by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus order by  l_returnflag,  l_linestatus ;

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#21'  and p_type not like 'STANDARD BRUSHED%'  and p_size in (5, 40, 22, 8, 29, 9, 36, 1)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;

select c_address, o_custkey, r_regionkey, r_name from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where n_name = 'UNITED KINGDOM' AND o_orderdate < '1995-01-28' AND o_comment = 'ggle. carefully ironic ideas' order by r_regionkey ASC, r_name DESC, o_custkey ASC

SELECT ps_comment, s_name, p_mfgr, r_comment, n_name FROM region JOIN nation ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey JOIN supplier ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN part ON p_partkey = ps_partkey WHERE r_name < 'AMERICA' AND ps_availqty = 8560 AND n_comment = 'al foxes promise slyly according to the regular accounts. bold requests alon'

select n_name, o_orderstatus, n_comment from orders, customer, nation where o_orderdate < '1993-09-13' AND c_acctbal = 1481.44 AND o_shippriority = 0 AND c_mktsegment > 'BUILDING' AND o_shippriority < 0

SELECT o_comment, c_nationkey FROM customer, orders WHERE o_comment >= 'ticing requests haggle slyly blithely express tithes. blithe' AND o_totalprice < 145293.14 AND c_comment >= 'ed to are fluffily. foxes hag' AND c_phone = '13-268-469-1359'

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'FRANCE' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'EUROPE'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'LARGE ANODIZED BRASS'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  l_shipmode,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'    or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as high_line_count,  sum(case   when o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT'    and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'    then 1   else 0  end) as low_line_count from  orders,  lineitem where  o_orderkey = l_orderkey  and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'MAIL')  and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate  and l_shipdate < l_commitdate  and l_receiptdate >= date '1993-01-01'  and l_receiptdate < date '1993-01-01' + interval '1' year group by  l_shipmode order by  l_shipmode ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'ROMANIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'EUROPE'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'ECONOMY POLISHED STEEL'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

SELECT p_mfgr, ps_availqty, MIN(p_container) FROM part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey WHERE ps_availqty = 9188 AND p_mfgr <> 'Manufacturer#4' AND ps_partkey <= 180166 GROUP BY p_mfgr, ps_availqty HAVING MIN(p_container) = 'JUMBO CASE'

SELECT l_shipinstruct, o_orderstatus, ps_partkey, MIN(ps_comment) FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey WHERE o_orderkey >= 5504608 AND l_shipinstruct <> 'DELIVER IN PERSON' AND l_suppkey = 8540 GROUP BY l_shipinstruct, o_orderstatus, ps_partkey HAVING MIN(ps_comment) <= 'arefully quiet instructions wake along the slyly'

select  nation,  o_year,  sum(amount) as sum_profit from  (   select    n_name as nation,    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    partsupp,    orders,    nation   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_partkey = l_partkey    and p_partkey = l_partkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and p_name like '%moccasin%'  ) as profit group by  nation,  o_year order by  nation,  o_year desc ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'SAUDI ARABIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'LARGE PLATED NICKEL'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select l_shipinstruct, ps_comment, p_comment from lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN part ON p_partkey = ps_partkey where l_partkey = 120307 AND ps_comment = 'the quick excuses use daringly around the blithely pending packages. foxes use quickly. fluffily r' AND l_shipmode <= 'SHIP' AND p_mfgr <= 'Manufacturer#4'

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'VIETNAM' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'SMALL BRUSHED TIN'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue from  lineitem where  l_shipdate >= date '1993-01-01'  and l_shipdate < date '1993-01-01' + interval '1' year  and l_discount between 0.04 - 0.01 and 0.04 + 0.01  and l_quantity < 24 ;

select  cntrycode,  count(*) as numcust,  sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from  (   select    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,    c_acctbal   from    customer   where    substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in     ('16', '20', '29', '28', '13', '19', '23')    and c_acctbal > (     select      avg(c_acctbal)     from      customer     where      c_acctbal > 0.00      and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in       ('16', '20', '29', '28', '13', '19', '23')    )    and not exists (     select      *     from      orders     where      o_custkey = c_custkey    )  ) as custsale group by  cntrycode order by  cntrycode ;

SELECT o_orderkey, l_commitdate FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderpriority > '5-LOW' AND l_partkey <> 25 AND l_comment <= 'pinto beans. pending, spec' AND o_orderstatus <> 'P' ORDER BY o_orderkey ASC, l_commitdate DESC

select c_nationkey, o_custkey, n_regionkey, o_orderdate from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where c_name = 'Customer#000105702' AND r_name < 'ASIA' AND o_comment = 'l orbits around the' order by c_nationkey ASC, n_regionkey DESC, o_orderdate ASC

select  nation,  o_year,  sum(amount) as sum_profit from  (   select    n_name as nation,    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    partsupp,    orders,    nation   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_partkey = l_partkey    and p_partkey = l_partkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and p_name like '%pale%'  ) as profit group by  nation,  o_year order by  nation,  o_year desc ;

select  s_acctbal,  s_name,  n_name,  p_partkey,  p_mfgr,  s_address,  s_phone,  s_comment from  part,  supplier,  partsupp,  nation,  region where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey  and p_size = 35  and p_type like '%TIN'  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_regionkey = r_regionkey  and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'  and ps_supplycost = (   select    min(ps_supplycost)   from    partsupp,    supplier,    nation,    region   where    p_partkey = ps_partkey    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'  ) order by  s_acctbal desc,  n_name,  s_name,  p_partkey limit 100;

select  l_orderkey,  sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority from  customer,  orders,  lineitem where  c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE'  and c_custkey = o_custkey  and l_orderkey = o_orderkey  and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-23'  and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-23' group by  l_orderkey,  o_orderdate,  o_shippriority order by  revenue desc,  o_orderdate limit 10;

select s_nationkey, ps_supplycost from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_availqty >= 1268 AND s_comment < 'about the silently quiet deposits. quickly e' AND ps_partkey <= 173618 AND s_nationkey < 17 AND s_acctbal > 6305.29 AND ps_supplycost <= 628.53

SELECT o_comment FROM orders WHERE o_comment <= 'carefully about the unusual requ' AND o_clerk <= 'Clerk#000000649' AND o_totalprice < 130861.55 AND o_orderpriority >= '3-MEDIUM' AND o_orderstatus <= 'F' AND o_shippriority <= 0 ORDER BY o_comment DESC

SELECT l_comment, s_name, ps_partkey FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE l_shipinstruct <> 'NONE' AND s_name = 'Supplier#000000551' AND s_suppkey <> 1933 ORDER BY ps_partkey DESC, s_name ASC

select  s_name,  s_address from  supplier,  nation where  s_suppkey in (   select    ps_suppkey   from    partsupp   where    ps_partkey in (     select      p_partkey     from      part     where      p_name like 'red%'    )    and ps_availqty > (     select      0.5 * sum(l_quantity)     from      lineitem     where      l_partkey = ps_partkey      and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey      and l_shipdate >= date '1997-01-01'      and l_shipdate < date '1997-01-01' + interval '1' year    )  )  and s_nationkey = n_nationkey  and n_name = 'UNITED STATES' order by  s_name ;
select l_commitdate, ps_availqty from lineitem, partsupp where l_linestatus = 'O' AND l_orderkey < 4758179 AND l_tax < 0.07 AND l_extendedprice = 72229.68

select ps_availqty, l_partkey, o_orderdate from orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey where l_shipinstruct > 'NONE' AND o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' AND l_returnflag >= 'N' AND l_returnflag = 'N'

select  100.00 * sum(case   when p_type like 'PROMO%'    then l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)   else 0  end) / sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as promo_revenue from  lineitem,  part where  l_partkey = p_partkey  and l_shipdate >= date '1993-10-01'  and l_shipdate < date '1993-10-01' + interval '1' month ;

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'INDIA' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'ASIA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'STANDARD ANODIZED NICKEL'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#21'  and p_type not like 'ECONOMY POLISHED%'  and p_size in (7, 42, 20, 12, 44, 37, 9, 15)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;

select l_orderkey, p_name, ps_partkey from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_linestatus = 'O' AND p_size = 1 AND l_commitdate <= '1998-10-10' AND ps_supplycost < 181.68 AND ps_comment > 'ronic dolphins must wake slyly ruthlessly bold ideas. furiously even requests across the quickly ironic in' order by ps_partkey DESC, p_name ASC
select l_receiptdate, l_suppkey from orders, lineitem where o_orderpriority >= '5-LOW' AND o_totalprice = 168844.46 AND o_custkey > 71746 AND l_tax > 0.02 order by l_receiptdate DESC, l_suppkey ASC

select  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year,  sum(volume) as revenue from  (   select    n1.n_name as supp_nation,    n2.n_name as cust_nation,    extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume   from    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and c_custkey = o_custkey    and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and (     (n1.n_name = 'MOZAMBIQUE' and n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')     or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'MOZAMBIQUE')    )    and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'  ) as shipping group by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year order by  supp_nation,  cust_nation,  l_year ;

select  sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly from  lineitem,  part where  p_partkey = l_partkey  and p_brand = 'Brand#25'  and p_container = 'LG JAR'  and l_quantity < (   select    0.2 * avg(l_quantity)   from    lineitem   where    l_partkey = p_partkey  ) ;

select s_suppkey, ps_availqty, n_nationkey from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey where n_regionkey < 0 AND n_comment >= 'hely enticingly express accounts. even, final' AND ps_availqty >= 9419 order by ps_availqty ASC

select  nation,  o_year,  sum(amount) as sum_profit from  (   select    n_name as nation,    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    partsupp,    orders,    nation   where    s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey    and ps_partkey = l_partkey    and p_partkey = l_partkey    and o_orderkey = l_orderkey    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey    and p_name like '%sky%'  ) as profit group by  nation,  o_year order by  nation,  o_year desc ;

select ps_supplycost, ps_partkey from partsupp JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where ps_availqty >= 9048 AND s_acctbal < 897.14 AND s_nationkey <= 13 AND s_nationkey < 17 AND ps_supplycost > 57.43 AND s_comment <= 'quests could use furiously across the ironic, even f'
select o_custkey from orders where o_clerk = 'Clerk#000000951' AND o_orderstatus <= 'O' AND o_shippriority >= 0 AND o_orderkey = 1472992 order by o_custkey ASC

select  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size,  count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from  partsupp,  part where  p_partkey = ps_partkey  and p_brand <> 'Brand#54'  and p_type not like 'MEDIUM PLATED%'  and p_size in (8, 41, 19, 17, 29, 6, 26, 18)  and ps_suppkey not in (   select    s_suppkey   from    supplier   where    s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'  ) group by  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size order by  supplier_cnt desc,  p_brand,  p_type,  p_size ;

select c_nationkey, o_custkey, n_regionkey, r_name from orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey where c_name = 'Customer#000116589' AND o_orderdate < '1995-01-28' AND o_comment = 'ggle. carefully ironic ideas' order by o_custkey ASC, n_regionkey DESC, r_name ASC

select  o_year,  sum(case   when nation = 'MOROCCO' then volume   else 0  end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from  (   select    extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,    n2.n_name as nation   from    part,    supplier,    lineitem,    orders,    customer,    nation n1,    nation n2,    region   where    p_partkey = l_partkey    and s_suppkey = l_suppkey    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey    and o_custkey = c_custkey    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey    and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey    and r_name = 'AFRICA'    and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'    and p_type = 'STANDARD ANODIZED TIN'  ) as all_nations group by  o_year order by  o_year ;

select l_shipmode, ps_partkey, s_name, min(s_name), sum(ps_partkey) from lineitem JOIN partsupp ON ps_suppkey = l_suppkey JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey where s_comment = 'ic requests nag. blithely regular ideas try to wake quickly eve' AND l_partkey < 179531 AND s_phone > '25-585-189-5975' group by l_shipmode, ps_partkey, s_name having min(s_name) <= 'Supplier#000006418' order by sum(ps_partkey) DESC, min(s_name) ASC

SELECT o_totalprice, c_acctbal, n_name, r_comment FROM orders JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN nation ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN region ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey WHERE c_nationkey >= 24 AND n_regionkey <> 0 AND n_nationkey <= 6 ORDER BY c_acctbal ASC, n_name ASC, r_comment DESC, o_totalprice DESC
SELECT ps_supplycost, p_partkey FROM partsupp, part WHERE p_size <> 10 AND ps_availqty = 7950 AND ps_supplycost >= 883.81 AND p_brand <> 'Brand#52' ORDER BY p_partkey ASC

select  sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly from  lineitem,  part where  p_partkey = l_partkey  and p_brand = 'Brand#34'  and p_container = 'LG DRUM'  and l_quantity < (   select    0.2 * avg(l_quantity)   from    lineitem   where    l_partkey = p_partkey  ) ;

select l_orderkey, p_name, ps_partkey from part JOIN partsupp ON ps_partkey = p_partkey JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey where l_linestatus = 'O' AND p_type = 'LARGE ANODIZED BRASS' AND l_commitdate = '1993-06-14' AND l_orderkey < 3692354 AND ps_comment > 'fully even ideas. blithely express accounts thrash blithely regular pinto beans. packages need to unwind pending excuses. final packages after the packages are furiously silently final co' order by ps_partkey DESC, p_name ASC
